gestureRules.name: Smooth Sweep
gestureRules.description: Continuous, deliberate movement from one position to another
gestureRules.pattern: Linear or curved path with steady velocity

outputs.x: Ramps smoothly from start to end value
outputs.y: Ramps smoothly from start to end value

gestureRules.practiceExercise: Practice straight line sweeps on Y-axis for filter control

gestureRules.name: Quick Flick
gestureRules.description: Fast movement followed by immediate stop
gestureRules.practiceExercise: Practice creating consistent speed spikes for rhythmic accents

gestureRules.name: Circular Orbit
gestureRules.description: Continuous circular movement around a center point
gestureRules.pattern: Periodic X and Y oscillation with 90° phase offset
gestureRules.practiceExercise: Trace circles at different speeds for consistent modulation

gestureRules.name: Spiral Motion
gestureRules.description: Circular path with increasing or decreasing radius
gestureRules.practiceExercise: Start with tight circles, gradually spiral outward

gestureRules.name: Figure-8 (Lemniscate)
gestureRules.description: Horizontal figure-8 pattern creating complex modulation
gestureRules.pattern: X oscillates at 2x frequency of Y with phase relationship

gestureRules.name: Bounce/Oscillation
gestureRules.pattern: Rapid Y movement with minimal X variation
gestureRules.practiceExercise: Rapid up-down movements while keeping X steady

gestureRules.name: Corner Snap
gestureRules.pattern: Direct path to extreme positions (0% or 100%)

outputs.speed: High during movement, zero at corners

gestureRules.practiceExercise: Practice hitting exact corners quickly and accurately

gestureRules.name: 3D Throw
gestureRules.description: Diagonal movement with simultaneous Z control
gestureRules.pattern: X/Y movement while scrolling/pinching for Z
gestureRules.practiceExercise: Coordinate X/Y drag with scroll wheel for Z

gestureRules.name: Tap and Hold
gestureRules.description: Quick engagement followed by sustained position
gestureRules.pattern: Rapid movement to position, then static hold

outputs.acceleration: Spike at start, negative at hold

gestureRules.practiceExercise: Tap to specific positions, hold, then release

gestureCombinations.name: Build and Release
gestureCombinations.pattern: Long sweep up (build), quick flick down (release)
gestureCombinations.musicalUse: Classic filter sweep for EDM builds

gestureCombinations.name: 3D Spatial Throw
gestureCombinations.pattern: Throw to position, then sweep in 3D space

gestureCombinations.name: Stutter Build
gestureCombinations.pattern: Rapid bouncing accelerating into smooth sweep
